title: TKA Bahasa Inggris Tingkat Lanjut - Menilai Argumen dan Kredibilitas Informasi
subtitle: Latihan Mandiri 20 Soal
difficulty_summary: 30% Mudah | 50% Sedang | 20% Sulit. Kerjakan dengan jujur dan teliti.

passages.title: Energy Drinks: A Smart Choice for Students?
text: During exam weeks, many students reach for energy drinks to stay awake while studying late. Advertisements present these drinks as the secret to better focus and performance. But are they really a smart choice?

Energy drinks usually contain large amounts of caffeine and sugar. A single can may contain as much caffeine as one or two cups of coffee, and some contain more than the amount of sugar that health organizations recommend for a whole day. Caffeine does make people feel more alert for a short time, and research shows it can improve reaction time.

However, the benefits come at a cost. Too much caffeine can cause a racing heart, anxiety, and difficulty sleeping. Sleep is essential for memory: studies show that the brain processes and stores what we have learned while we sleep. A student who stays up late with energy drinks may therefore remember less than a student who sleeps properly.

My cousin drank three cans a night during his final exams, and he failed two subjects. This proves that energy drinks destroy students' academic performance. Everyone knows that people who drink them are lazy and depend on shortcuts instead of studying properly.

A better strategy is to plan study time over several weeks, take short breaks, drink water, and get seven to nine hours of sleep. These habits may not be as exciting as a colourful can, but they are supported by solid evidence.

passages.title: Two Reports on a Herbal Supplement
text:
Text A (a post on a personal blog)
"I've been taking SuperLeaf capsules for two weeks and I feel AMAZING! My skin is clearer, I've lost three kilos, and I haven't had a cold once. SuperLeaf is 100% natural, so it's completely safe. Doctors don't want you to know about it because it works better than medicine! Click the link below to buy it with my special discount code."

Text B (a news report on a national news website)
The national food and drug agency has issued a warning about SuperLeaf, an herbal supplement sold online. Laboratory tests carried out by the agency found that some samples contained a prescription weight-loss drug that was not listed on the label. The drug can cause heart problems in some people and should only be taken under medical supervision. The agency has asked online marketplaces to remove the product and advised consumers who have bought it to stop using it and consult a doctor if they experience side effects. The company that sells SuperLeaf has not responded to requests for comment.

passages.title: Why Every Student Needs a Tablet
text: Technology is changing education, and schools that do not adapt will be left behind. That is why every student in our country should receive a tablet computer from the government.

Tablets give students access to a whole library of digital textbooks, which are lighter than printed books and can be updated easily. In a pilot programme at ten schools in one province, students who used tablets for a year scored eight percent higher in reading tests than they had the year before.

Furthermore, every successful country in the world gives its students tablets. If we want our children to compete globally, we must do the same. Anyone who disagrees with this plan simply does not care about the future of our children.

Some people worry about the cost. But the price of tablets keeps falling, and digital textbooks would save money on printing. Others say students will use tablets for games and social media. However, schools can install software that blocks certain websites during lessons.
The choice is simple: either we give every student a tablet, or we accept that our education system will fail.

passages.title: Is the Memory Boost Pro App Worth It?
text:
Text A (an online advertisement)
Memory Boost Pro: the app that makes you SMARTER in just 10 days! Nine out of ten users say their memory improved. Our brain-training games were created by scientists, and thousands of happy students already use them. Don't be left behind. Buy now for only Rp199,000, and your exam scores will go up!

Text B (a comment by an education researcher in a science magazine)
Many brain-training apps make bold promises, but research tells a more careful story. A review of 20 studies found that people who used such apps became better at the games themselves, but there was little evidence that the improvement carried over to school subjects or everyday memory. Most studies were small, and some were paid for by app companies. The researcher advises students to treat advertising claims with caution and to rely on proven study habits such as regular sleep, practice testing, and spaced revision.

questions.question: According to the text, what positive effect of caffeine is supported by research?

options.B: It improves long-term memory.
options.C: It helps people sleep better.
options.D: It reduces anxiety during exams.

questions.explanation: Paragraf 2: research shows it can improve reaction time. Efek lain justru disebut sebagai dampak negatif.

questions.question: Why might a student who drinks energy drinks to study late remember less?

options.A: Energy drinks contain too much water.
options.B: Energy drinks are more expensive than coffee.
options.C: Caffeine makes reading slower.
options.D: Lack of sleep interferes with how the brain stores learning.

questions.explanation: Paragraf 3: otak mengolah dan menyimpan pelajaran saat tidur, sehingga begadang dapat mengurangi daya ingat.

questions.question: What is the main weakness of the argument in paragraph 4?

options.A: It uses too many scientific terms.
options.B: It agrees with the advertisements.
options.C: It gives too much statistical evidence.
options.D: It draws a general conclusion from a single personal example.

questions.explanation: Menilai kelogisan: satu kasus sepupu tidak cukup untuk menyimpulkan bahwa minuman energi destroy students' academic performance. Ini generalisasi tergesa-gesa (hasty generalization). Bisa saja ia gagal karena sebab lain.

questions.question:
Decide whether each statement is a supported claim (based on evidence) or an unsupported claim in the text.
(1) Sleep helps the brain store what we have learned.
(2) People who drink energy drinks are lazy.
(3) A can may contain as much caffeine as one or two cups of coffee.

options.A: (1) Supported claim; (2) Unsupported claim; (3) Supported claim
options.B: (1) Supported claim; (2) Supported claim; (3) Supported claim
options.C: (1) Supported claim; (2) Unsupported claim; (3) Unsupported claim
options.D: (1) Unsupported claim; (2) Unsupported claim; (3) Supported claim

questions.explanation: Peran tidur didukung studies show, dan kandungan kafein adalah fakta yang dapat diukur. Everyone knows that people who drink them are lazy adalah klaim tanpa bukti yang menyerang pribadi.

questions.question: Which paragraph weakens the text most and should be removed or rewritten with evidence?

options.B: Paragraph 3
options.C: Paragraph 4
options.D: Paragraph 5

questions.explanation: Paragraf 4 berisi anekdot dan generalisasi yang melemahkan teks yang selebihnya berbasis bukti. Paragraf 2, 3, dan 5 menyajikan informasi dan saran yang didukung penelitian.

questions.question: What did laboratory tests find in some SuperLeaf samples?

options.B: Nothing unusual
options.C: Harmful bacteria
options.D: A prescription drug not listed on the label

questions.explanation: Text B: some samples contained a prescription weight-loss drug that was not listed on the label.

questions.question: Why is Text B more credible than Text A?

options.A: It reports tests by an official agency and seeks a response from the company.
options.B: It is longer.
options.C: It uses more exciting language.
options.D: It was written by someone who used the product.

questions.explanation: Kredibilitas: Text B memuat sumber resmi (badan pengawas), bukti uji laboratorium, dan upaya konfirmasi kepada perusahaan. Text A hanya pengalaman pribadi dan memiliki kepentingan jualan (kode diskon).

questions.question:
Which features of Text A suggest that it may not be reliable?
(1) The writer earns something from a discount code.
(2) It claims that natural products are always safe.
(3) It describes laboratory tests in detail.
(4) It says doctors are hiding the truth without giving evidence.
questions.explanation: Text A punya kepentingan komersial (1), membuat klaim keliru bahwa 100% natural berarti aman (2), dan menuduh dokter tanpa bukti (4). Text A tidak menyebut uji laboratorium sama sekali.

questions.question: Text A says the writer lost three kilos. Considering Text B, what is the most reasonable explanation?

options.A: The weight loss may have been caused by the hidden prescription drug.
options.B: The supplement is a safe natural miracle.
options.C: Text B proves the writer is lying.
options.D: Clear skin causes weight loss.

questions.explanation: Sintesis dua sumber: Text B menemukan obat penurun berat badan yang tidak tercantum di label. Ini penjelasan yang paling masuk akal atas klaim Text A. Text B tidak membuktikan bahwa penulis blog berbohong.

questions.question: What should a person who has bought SuperLeaf do, according to Text B?

options.A: Keep using it for another two weeks
options.B: Return it using the discount code
options.C: Stop using it and consult a doctor if they have side effects
options.D: Write a review on a blog

questions.explanation: advised consumers ... to stop using it and consult a doctor if they experience side effects.

questions.question: What does the writer want the government to do?

options.B: Give every student a tablet
options.C: Print more textbooks
options.D: Block social media

questions.explanation: every student in our country should receive a tablet computer from the government.

questions.question: Which piece of evidence in the text is the most specific?

options.B: Students in a pilot programme scored eight percent higher in reading tests.
options.C: Every successful country gives its students tablets.
options.D: Tablets are lighter than printed books.

questions.explanation: Data program uji coba memuat angka, jumlah sekolah, dan rentang waktu. Pernyataan lain bersifat umum tanpa sumber.

questions.question: What is a limitation of the pilot programme evidence?

options.B: It compares students with their own scores the year before, so other factors might explain the rise.
options.C: It was about mathematics, not reading.
options.D: It shows that tablets make scores fall.

questions.explanation: Tanpa kelompok pembanding, kenaikan nilai bisa disebabkan faktor lain (misalnya siswa bertambah dewasa atau guru berbeda). Bukti ini menarik tetapi belum cukup kuat.

questions.question:
Which sentences contain faulty reasoning?
(1) Anyone who disagrees with this plan simply does not care about the future of our children.
(2) Digital textbooks can be updated easily.
(3) Either we give every student a tablet, or we accept that our education system will fail.
(4) Schools can install software that blocks certain websites during lessons.
questions.explanation: (1) menyerang orang yang tidak setuju, bukan argumennya. (3) adalah dilema palsu (false dilemma): seolah hanya ada dua pilihan. (2) dan (4) adalah pernyataan yang masuk akal.

questions.question: The claim every successful country in the world gives its students tablets is weak because ....

options.B: it is an overgeneralization without evidence
options.C: it is based on a pilot study
options.D: it mentions the cost of tablets

questions.explanation: Kata every membuat klaim terlalu luas, dan penulis tidak memberi data atau contoh negara. Ini generalisasi berlebihan.

questions.question: What does Text A promise?

options.A: That users will become smarter and their exam scores will go up
options.B: That the app is free for all students
options.C: That scientists will visit the users' schools
options.D: That the app will replace studying completely

questions.explanation: Iklan menjanjikan pengguna SMARTER in just 10 days dan nilai ujian akan naik. Iklan tidak menyebut aplikasi gratis atau menggantikan belajar.

questions.question: According to Text B, what did people who used brain-training apps get better at?

options.B: The games themselves
options.C: Everyday memory
options.D: Reading speed

questions.explanation: Text B: pengguna became better at the games themselves, tetapi bukti bahwa kemampuan itu berpindah ke pelajaran sekolah atau ingatan sehari-hari masih sangat sedikit.

questions.question: What does the sentence Don't be left behind in Text A try to do?

options.A: Warn readers about a danger in the app
options.B: Give readers information about the price
options.C: Make readers feel pressure to buy the app immediately
options.D: Explain how the games were created

questions.explanation: Kalimat itu memakai tekanan sosial (takut ketinggalan) agar pembaca segera membeli. Ini teknik persuasi, bukan informasi atau bukti.

questions.question: Why is the claim Nine out of ten users say their memory improved weak?

options.A: It is too small a number to be believed.
options.B: It is taken from a scientific magazine.
options.C: It shows that most users are not satisfied.
options.D: It depends on what users say, without telling us how many were asked or how memory was measured.

questions.explanation: Menilai bukti: klaim itu hanya berdasar pengakuan pengguna, tanpa jumlah responden, cara mengukur ingatan, atau pembanding. Persentase tinggi tidak otomatis berarti bukti kuat.

questions.question: Which statement about the two texts is most accurate?

options.A: Both texts agree that the app improves exam scores.
options.B: Text B proves that the app is harmful to students.
options.C: Both texts are equally reliable because they mention research.
options.D: Text B uses evidence from a review of studies and mentions limitations, while Text A offers only unverified claims.

questions.explanation: Text B menyebut tinjauan 20 studi, mengakui keterbatasan (studi kecil, sebagian dibiayai perusahaan), dan tidak melebih-lebihkan. Text A hanya menyajikan klaim tanpa sumber yang dapat diperiksa, dan penjualnya punya kepentingan.
